authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0030 at critical severity forbids presenting the Cardinal Scale or California Hot Springs as verified, so the primary verification requirement is kept and the composite framing is restored alongside it. CTD-0044 keeps Land-NFT and SDAC outside the canonical stack, which the restored text states while explaining what each label was reaching for. CTD-0042 keeps the Entelechy and Membrane identity an open question. CTD-0046 governs Proof of Council validation, which stays undefined and is said to be.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. The spring paragraph, the verification requirement on California Hot Springs, and the sentence that difficulties are not automatically virtues are all absent from the baseline. All three are retained, and the spring is named in the volume card among the images that must not be explained away.

findings.summary: The definition of a Scale lost the claim that makes the unit interesting.

evidence.baseline: Each Scale is the smallest *complete* expression of the entire thesis, not a chapter of it, but the whole of it, made small enough to live in ... Build one Scale well and you have built a working piece of the new world.
evidence.shipped: Each Scale is meant to hold a small, complete expression of the thesis while remaining particular to its place.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and CTD-0030 read as requiring the build-one claim be dropped.
findings.diagnosis: Not a chapter of it but the whole of it made small enough to live in is the structural claim the volume is titled for, and it is what distinguishes a Scale from a pilot project. The build-one sentence does overclaim in the present tense and is rendered in the conditional, which is the repair CTD-0030 actually requires.

findings.summary: All six components of the stack lost their reasons and kept only their cautions.

evidence.baseline: A system that honors presence must be entered through an act of genuine presence, never a click ... Money’s honest cousin: a memory system, like all money, that remembers what money is structurally blind to ... This is the line between a Scale and a panopticon, and we hold it in our teeth ... protocol, not platform; federation, not headquarters.
evidence.shipped: Entry must be voluntary, accessible, and free of pressure ... Neither path may convert physiology, charisma, or conformity into a measure of human worth ... That safeguard needs implementation, audit, and a threat model before it can be called architecture ... Their ownership, authority, and relationship to The Purposeful Foundation remain to be designed.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0006, CTD-0030, and CTD-0046, read as requiring each component be replaced by its open problem.
findings.diagnosis: Every caution here is correct and every one is kept. What went with them is the account of what each component is for, and a stack described only by its unsolved problems cannot be evaluated, which is the opposite of what a builder’s manual owes a builder. The line between a Scale and a panopticon is also the sentence that states the stake of the Coherence Engine, and the pass replaced it with the true but weaker observation that saying so is not doing so. Both are now present, in that order.

findings.summary: The water passage lost its reason and kept only its verification requirement.

evidence.baseline: The Dragon of Earth Awakening was always, in the oldest tellings, the keeper of the waters ... a people who gather to revere, to worship, and to steward the water they live beside are practicing, at the scale of one watershed, the exact reverence the whole work is for. Worship is one of the Seven Initiates; stewardship is the long arc of the Master Human; and water is the first commons any community must hold rightly or perish.
evidence.shipped: Water remains an apt center for the proposal because no community can endure without stewarding it.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0030, correctly applied to the site claim.
findings.diagnosis: The item requires verification of the site. It says nothing about why water is the right center, and the baseline’s answer ties the choice to two named structures of the corpus, the Seven Initiates and the Master Human Arc. The re-render restores the reasoning, keeps the verification requirement on the site, and separates the two so the reasoning does not read as evidence about California Hot Springs.

findings.summary: The account of what would make a Scale real was cut to a caution.

evidence.baseline: It would be the sign of a community paying the actual price of its own principles, which is the one thing that makes a Scale real rather than imagined.
evidence.shipped: Those difficulties are not automatically virtues. They become useful evidence only when participants can speak freely about what failed and obtain remedy where harm occurred.

findings.authorizedBy: A fair objection to the baseline, which came close to treating hardship as proof.
findings.diagnosis: The objection is right and is kept. But paying the actual price of its own principles is the volume’s test for design fiction, and the four examples the baseline gives, the failing software, the accepted decline in polish, the declined gift, are the only concrete costs the section names. The one thing is reduced to part of what.

findings.summary: Audit finding: Proof of Council was still called the validated practice in the same sentence that says its validation procedure is undefined. Repaired.

evidence.baseline: through Proof of Council, the validated practice of gathering rightly in true council
evidence.shipped: Proof of Council is a proposed second path, the validated practice of gathering rightly in true council, and its validation procedure is not yet defined.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0046 under R-LEDGER-WINS, and catalog 4.13 on labels that imply a measurement that never occurred.
findings.diagnosis: The sentence granted the adjective and withdrew it in the same breath. The Providence chapter already renders the same term without validated and states that its validator remains undefined, so the volume disagreed with itself about one canonical term across two sections. Validated is removed here, which makes both ends of the term agree and leaves the caution intact.

findings.summary: Audit finding: the money's honest cousin formulation shipped without the comparison and the middle term the settled generation lists as restored. Applied now.

evidence.baseline: Money's honest cousin: a memory system, like all money, that remembers what money is structurally blind to, the quality of a presence, the depth of a listening, the trust a person has actually earned.
evidence.shipped: Money's honest cousin, in intent: a memory system that would remember what money is structurally blind to, the quality of a presence and the trust a person has actually earned.

findings.authorizedBy: R-PROPORTION, since no defect authorized the loss, and this record's restored note naming the currency as money's honest cousin.
findings.diagnosis: Like all money is the claim that makes the cousin image an argument rather than a compliment: money is already a memory system, and this one would remember what money forgets. The depth of a listening is the triad's most concrete member. Both return, with the re-render's in intent and would kept, so the restored image stays inside the proposal register CTD-0030 requires.

findings.summary: Audit finding: the corpus, an editorial term, stood in reader-facing prose. Repaired.

evidence.baseline: (no baseline counterpart; the honesty sentence is the re-render's)
evidence.shipped: Elsewhere the corpus gives that composite several incompatible populations and implementation states

findings.diagnosis: The admission is right and stays. The word corpus belongs to the editorial system's register, not the volume's, which says the work, the series, and this volume. Now reads: Other volumes give that composite several incompatible populations and implementation states. Equal precision, the volume's own diction.

findings.summary: Audit adjudication of a previously silent cut: the baseline's closing restatement of the water passage is not restored.

evidence.baseline: A Scale built around water is the thesis in its most elemental form.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.8, defect limb, with R-REMOVE-BURDEN discharged.
findings.diagnosis: The paragraph has just argued the same proposition in particulars: the keeper of the waters, the Seven Initiates, the Master Human arc, and the first commons. The final sentence names the claim again at a higher altitude and adds no new ground. The re-render cut it without recording the cut; the audit records it now. It contributed a summary a paragraph this concrete did not need, and the paragraph lands on hold rightly or perish, the stronger beat.

findings.summary: Credit under R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: the hardship limit repaired a genuine fault in the baseline and is kept beside the restored price claim.

evidence.baseline: None of this would be a flaw. It would be the sign of a community paying the actual price of its own principles, which is the one thing that makes a Scale real rather than imagined.
evidence.shipped: But difficulty is not automatically virtue. Hardship becomes useful evidence only when participants can speak freely about what failed and obtain remedy where harm occurred.

findings.diagnosis: The baseline came one step from treating hardship as proof of authenticity, which is how communities excuse harm. The pass's limit, that hardship counts as evidence only where it can be spoken about and remedied, repairs a genuine fault, and the re-render kept it beside the restored price claim. Recorded at the same weight as a loss.

debtImpact.note: California Hot Springs is named as one proposed first ground and its land, organization, participant count, legal status, operational state, and consent to publication are all named as requiring primary verification. The composite framing is restored and the corpus’s incompatible populations are acknowledged.

Land-NFT and SDAC stay outside the canonical stack. What each label was reaching for is described so that a future definition has something to work from, which is the item’s alternative to retirement.
Entelechy is described as Volume VII’s philosophical term and whether it should name this technical layer is left open.
Proof of Council’s validator, evidence, consent, and appeal remain undefined and the section says so.
ICONS plural, Scale singular, stated in the second paragraph.
The population figure near 150 keeps the note that its relationship to nested groups and a bioregional community is unresolved.

generations.title: Derived from baseline under the thirteen rules

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Seventeen em dashes. Seven set off appositives naming components and became commas. Six introduced specifications and became colons. Four framed parentheticals and were rebuilt as clauses or separate sentences.
Every present-tense assertion about the stack rendered in the conditional or as intent, following CTD-0030 and the card’s instruction to reduce the unit is sound and the first ground exists.

The smallest complete expression, the never a click principle, the Membrane’s function, the currency as money’s honest cousin, the panopticon line, protocol and federation, the whole-machine sentence, the composite and its dimensions, the keeper of the waters, and the actual price of its own principles.

The verification requirement on the site, the corpus’s incompatible populations, every safeguarding caution on the six components, the exclusion of Land-NFT and SDAC from the stack, the spring paragraph, and the requirement that hardship be speakable and remediable before it counts as evidence.

openQuestions.question: Heading not changed. Baseline: §2, What a Scale Is. Current: What a Scale Is. Only the section number differs. The volume card lists five numbered sections among the protected structural devices and the numbering is absent from the current headings. A heading determines a section id, and a section id is a public route with recorded aliases, so the difference is recorded rather than acted on.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the volume-09 voice card, editorial/sources/corpus/voice-card.md, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. This section is the volume’s clearest case of a stack described entirely by its open problems, which reads as candour and functions as absence.

A floor, not a fidelity measure: a restored sentence that differs by one hedge or repaired mark does not count.

R-PAIRED-DELETION term sweep: the Doors, the Membrane, the Coherence Engine, and the Container are each defined here and used in the whole-stack sentence; Land-NFT and SDAC appear only inside their exclusion; the Seven Initiates and the Master Human resolve against the Volume VII recap and Volume VIII; Proof of Council now agrees with its other end in the Providence chapter after F5.

One softening checked and left: ICONS learning to move together, where the baseline said move as one body. The body image now lives only in the closing as an open question, which is where the federation claim belongs under CTD-0030. No fire.
R-DEIXIS: These are present names, not last ones, proximal and correct. R-TENSE: has been drawn as a composite is load bearing. R-LAND: every paragraph ends on its own beat.
